hook_line: SENSEX ADDS 308 POINTS AS NIFTY RECLAIMS 23,000 IN SECOND STRAIGHT RALLY

hook_stat.sub: Points the Sensex rose on Friday to close at 74,459.53

stats.label: Climb in the Nifty IT index on Friday
Jump in Trent shares after a 25% rise in quarterly net profit

diaspora_bullets: October snapped a two-month losing streak for Indian benchmarks
The rupee firmed 33 paise to 94.93 per dollar on Friday
news_summary: The Sensex closed 308.49 points higher at 74,459.53 and the Nifty rose 116.35 points to 23,053.10 on Friday, a second straight gain led by IT and pharma stocks.
payoff: A rally carried by a handful of heavyweights, with midcaps and smallcaps falling, needs broader participation to hold.
